observed: The desk (dialin) was still being developed as a hand-rolled application: its own palette table (POPIT_THEMES, themePaint, paintTheme), its own motion keyframes (settings-in, settings-pop/fold/snap/sweep, toast-in, panel-in) and its own settings panel implementation, all beside the signed settings app package rather than derived from it. The owner corrected the direction twice: the panel inside dialin is not a private settings app ("that setttings app withing dialin is the setting spp baseline, apps subscribe to the settings app from the store, it is not a private version of the settings app that dialin has, dialin needs to move to the upgraded formats") and then the whole approach ("the expectation was that the dialin would stop being handrolled in it's entirety and the cua drivers would take ver the work to rebuild the application from the settings app package"). Agent edits to the private copies are the wrong instrument: patching them again deepens the surface that is being retired.
correction: Dialin is retired as a hand-rolled app. The CUA driver owns the rebuild from the signed settings app package: frame, material, motion type, motion preference, the ten colour roles, per-app layout and DPI, painted through contour-theme.css and package.js, inside the window's declared regions (bar, status, body, foot), delivered as app-dialin@<rev> and audited before signing. The rebuild was handed over as driver wish task-0003 (intent read, receipt /srv/scratch/popit-dialin-rebuild.json, kept probe data/probes/2026-11-25-dialin-rebuild-handover.py). tools/freshness.py carries it as the stale row dialin-rebuild with the driver act, and the gate reads that receipt. The stopgap edits made before this ruling (toast.css derived from --popit-* roles, contour-theme surface-motion instead of private keyframes, adoptSignedTheme writing data-motion-preference, package.js LAYOUT_FLOOR without the retired ide) are recorded as stopgaps, not as the rebuild.
